part.text:
Set up the Go module with `golang.org/x/net` for extended networking primitives.

- `go.mod` — module `example.com/netapp`, requires `golang.org/x/net v0.59.0`
- `main.go` — HTTP/2 (via `http2` + `h2c` cleartext handler) and WebSocket (`x/net/websocket`) server

Build, vet, and gofmt all pass (`CGO_ENABLED=0` needed here since no GCC env is loaded). Run with `CGO_ENABLED=0 go run .`.
